Desc_FR: Les cochons (nom anglais : pigs) sont des créatures passives qui peuvent être chevauchées avec une selle.
Desc_EN: A pig is a passive mob found commonly in most grassy biomes. Adult pigs are a source of porkchops and can be ridden using a saddle and a carrot on a stick. They have three variants based on the temperature of the biome they spawn in.
